visualCharacteristics: White band, 4-column row (col-lg-3, wraps to 2 at sm, 1 at xs): three article cards (image, blue h3, paragraph, bold 'Read more' link) and a What's New panel (blue header bar, light-blue body with news title, date, summary, 'read more'). Text-only news panel: light-blue boxed body, news title link-styled, bold date, summary, 'read more' link; sits as a narrow side column.
contentPattern: Dynamic news list: items link to news-details pages and carry a date; item count can change. Text-only cards (no images).

rows: h4 news title + date (strong) + summary paragraph + read more link
blockStructure.notes: What's New: one row per news item (1 on this page).

usage: What's New panel listing news items with title, bold date, summary and read more link.
reuseGuidance: Use for text-only dated news lists. One row per item; a paragraph containing only bold text is treated as the date and a paragraph containing only a link as the read-more link. Images are optional.
